Name: Finding Failed Fruit Trees
Author: pneuma163
Description:
A fruit tree that was not able to grow is a little annoying. Not knowing where that fruit tree is can be even more annoying. This mod adds a notification that includes the name of the location where a fruit tree was not able to grow instead of the game's own notification (this is configurable). It also prints the coordinate in the console for your reference.

Config options (which you can configure with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or in this mod's config.json file):
- MultipleNotifications: The game normally notifies you about the first failed fruit tree it found today. Enable this to be notified about all failed fruit trees. (default: true)
- ReplaceVanillaMessage: Replace the game's own original notification about a fruit tree that was not able to grow. (default: true)
- DaysToKeepNotifying: If a tree cannot grow after this many days, it will be ignored (default: always)

If you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28256]World Navigator[/url], any failed fruit trees will be added to World Navigator's Today's Points of Interest menu.

Consider this to be a companion mod to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25450]farm damage info mod[/url], but this mod does not provide fancy renders or arrows like that one does. To get arrows, install World Navigator and use its navigation guidance.
